steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json containing the dynamic app name 'Neon Sphere Run' and unique package path com.neonsphererun.app.

steps.title: Define Backend API Schema
steps.description: Configure the api_schema.json to declare that no online backend database is needed for this pure high-performance arcade action runner.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with SDK compile version 34, target 34, min SDK 21, and configuration for standard Java 8 features.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml to request high-performance graphics, set application icons, and lock orientation to portrait mode for easy single-thumb gameplay.

steps.title: Configure Application Color Resources
steps.description: Create colors.xml containing neon-themed values including Cyber Pink, Radiant Cyan, Toxic Green, and Deep Dark Void background colors.

steps.title: Create User Interface Overlay XML
steps.description: Implement activity_main.xml to set up the HUD displaying distance, speed multiplier, a futuristic main menu screen, and an interactive game-over statistics panel.

steps.title: Develop Retro Sound-Effects Synthesizer
steps.description: Implement SoundSynth.java using native Android AudioTrack to generate custom retro-synth soundwaves on-the-fly for jumps, speed-ups, and dramatic crash explosions.

steps.title: Build Main Activity
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java to bind the layout controls, coordinate UI visibility states, play contextual synth sound-effects, and persist high scores via SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Develop 3D Rendering Engine
steps.description: Create GameView.java and build the math-based perspective projection engine that draws 3D roads, moving gridlines, obstacles, and rolling sphere meshes onto a 2D canvas.

steps.title: Building Neon Sphere Run
steps.description: Run the Android build chain to compile, assemble the debug APK, and generate the final playable native arcade game package.
